prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: opaque 4:3 night sky and ocean backdrop for the Johnny Castaway Cartoon art pack. Create one finished raster background only.
Input image 1 is the original NIGHT.SCR composition reference. Follow its geometry: perfectly level horizon at 42.7% of image height; a round full moon centered at 25.8% of width and 17.9% of height, with diameter about 10.6% of image height; sparse small stars across the sky; a broken silver moonlight reflection below the moon that widens gradually toward the lower edge. Do not copy the old pixel dithering.
Input image 2 is the approved daytime Cartoon ocean, the style reference. Match its clean hand-painted cartoon rendering, broad simplified flat water shapes, softly varied surface texture, and crisp readable wave highlights. Transform this visual language into a peaceful moonlit scene while using image 1's lower horizon and moon placement, not image 2's horizon. Use deep indigo and blue for the sky, rich blue ocean with cool cyan-blue surface patterns and silvery pale highlights. Keep enough separation in the dark water to read clearly. The moon is softly shaded with understated craters and a restrained glow. The stars are sparse and modest, not a dense galaxy or giant starbursts.
Full image is edge-to-edge opaque artwork with no border, no labels, no text. No island, palm trees, characters, boats, rocks or shoreline foam, and no painted clouds: those are separate foreground and moving layers in the application. Keep the wide ocean foreground clear for the island overlay. No photorealism, no 3D, no black outlines around every water patch, no dramatic storm. Return a 4:3 image, ideally 1448x1086, suitable for uniform resizing to 1280x960.
